subject: Slate re-anchor request + escalation playbook
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@slatecorp.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Slate re-anchor request + escalation playbook

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call this morning. We heard procurement's timeline constraints loud and clear. To keep momentum without over-promising, I'm proposing a short re-anchor of the close date while we clear the remaining security and procurement checks.

Quick summary of the ask:
- New target close: 2026-09-03 (was 2026-08-01) — this gives Slate procurement ~5 extra weeks to finish their security review.
- In the meantime we propose a phased acceptance (pilot -> limited acceptance -> full acceptance) to let you take value earlier.
- Enclosed: MAP_v3.xlsx (updated milestones), risk_log.csv (key slippage drivers and mitigations).

Immediate asks for Slate:
1) Can procurement confirm the outstanding evidence they need (SOC2 scope, encryption, data residency)?
2) Are you open to a 60-day pilot with purchase order + a price protection clause for the remainder of the term?

I understand the delay is painful. If procurement needs an exec-to-exec uplift we can arrange that — I want to make sure our offer is concrete and reduces your internal friction.

Next steps: I'll wait for procurement's confirmed evidence list; Marcus and Mina are standing by to supply docs and a mitigation credit if needed.

Attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx, risk_log.csv

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0132
irene.choi@redwood.com

---
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@slatecorp.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@slatecorp.com>, procurement@slatecorp.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Slate re-anchor request + escalation playbook

Irene —

Appreciate the proactive plan. A few realities from procurement/security:
- Security team flagged an outstanding control: we need a recent SOC2 Type II report covering data processing and an explicit confirmation on KV cache handling for customer-owned keys.
- Data residency: legal wants written confirmation we can support EU-only storage for a scoped dataset (we're trialing EU customers next quarter).
- Pricing: procurement is okay with a pilot but will not sign the full SOW until the evidence is in. They asked if Redwood can provide a short-term credit if the timeline slips again.

We like the phased approach but cannot commit to the proposed 2026-09-03 close until the security items are validated. If you can provide the SOC2 package + a short technical note on KV cache and residency by end of week, we'll push procurement to prioritize.

Also, heads up: procurement may ask for a 30-45 day payment term for the pilot PO. Not ideal for you, but likely.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Director, Platform Partnerships | SlateCorp
alex.johnson@slatecorp.com

---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Slate re-anchor request + escalation playbook

Team —

Good context from Alex. We need a short, executable playbook to get Slate across the finish line while limiting Redwood's exposure. Proposed tactical options (pick one, deliverables & owners noted):

Option A — Accelerated pilot (low risk)
- Deliverable: 30-day scoped pilot for 2 teams, limited token volume, PO from Slate + 45-day payment term.
- Redwood commitment: price protection for full term if PO converts within 60 days.
- Owners: Irene (customer comms), Mina (security package + SOC2 pointer), Ben (pricing approval).

Option B — Rebaseline + conditional credit
- Deliverable: Move close to 2026-09-03 but add a conditional credit (5% SOW credit) if security evidence not provided by 2026-08-21.
- Redwood commitment: provide SOC2 package and technical note on KV cache & residency by 2026-07-24.
- Owners: Mina (evidence), Ben (pricing/credit approval), Jonas (exec escalation if needed).

Option C — Exec escalation (fastest path)
- Deliverable: Arrange a 30-minute exec call between Jonas and Slate SVP of Engineering + procurement director this week.
- Redwood commitment: stand up a dedicated onboarding engineer for priority customers to shorten acceptance window.
- Owners: Jonas (exec call), Irene (prep), Mina (technical brief).

Attachments: SOW_draft_v2.pdf, risk_log.csv (updated with option impact).

Irene — please confirm which option you want to offer and I will sign off the pricing/credit. If we go exec route, Jonas is available tomorrow morning PST.

Marcus Lin
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@slatecorp.com>, Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@slatecorp.com>, procurement@slatecorp.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: slate close — proposed Option B (rebaseline + conditional credit)

Alex / Patricia / Slate procurement team —

Per our thread and internal review, Redwood proposes Option B to unblock Slate procurement while protecting both parties. Summary:
- New target close: 2026-09-03 (rebaseline).
- Conditional credit: 5% credit on the initial SOW if Slate does not provide the outstanding security evidence (SOC2 Type II + KV cache handling confirmation) by 2026-08-21.
- Deliverables from Redwood by 2026-07-24: SOC2 package pointer, 2-page technical note on KV cache & data residency, SOW_draft_v2.pdf with pilot acceptance wording.

Why this helps:
- Gives procurement time to validate controls while Slate retains a clear economic path if the security team needs additional time.
- Keeps the deal moving without forcing a full SOW signature before evidence is in hand.

Immediate asks for Slate procurement: please confirm:
1) That the two items (SOC2 Type II, KV cache handling) are the only outstanding blockers; if there are others, list them by 2026-07-23 EOD.
2) Acceptance of the conditional credit structure above (yes/no) by 2026-07-23 EOD so we can finalize the MAP and SOW.

If procurement remains unable to confirm by 2026-07-23, we will escalate to an exec call (Jonas Weber is CC'd and available).
